title: AVAtt: A Free-Viewing Eye-Tracking Dataset and Benchmark for Visual Attention on Paintings
comment: Extenstion of https://doi.org/10.1145/3649902.3655656 published at ETRA 2024
summary:
Saliency and scanpath models are developed almost exclusively on natural photographs, yet paintings are composed by artists to guide the viewer's eye and differ from photographs in texture, colour and abstraction. We introduce \avatt, a free-viewing eye-tracking dataset on 
Images{} paintings spanning sixteen art movements and five centuries, with 
Scanpaths{} scanpaths and 
Fixations{} fixations from 
Participants{} participants (\spPerImageMin--\spPerImageMax{} observers per painting). For every painting we release individual scanpaths with fixation timing and eye--screen distance, fixation maps, saliency maps smoothed at one degree of visual angle, temporal saliency videos and rich art metadata. We benchmark classic and deep saliency models against human agreement, revealing substantial headroom for art-aware models, and rank 44 scanpath-similarity measures, including a new language-free family of image-encoder metrics built on ten CNN, ViT and self-supervised encoders. With controls that remove viewing biases, we show that faces are fixated  aceEnrich$	imes$ more than expected and within half a second, that local structure draws the eye, that composition rules fitted from image content predict where people look, and that art style shapes how much viewers agree. Dataset, code and a Python package are available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 AVATT 绘画自由观看眼动数据集（16 个艺术流派、5 个世纪），发布扫描路径、注视图、1°视角平滑显著图、时间显著视频及艺术元数据；基准评测经典与深度显著性/扫描路径模型，并排序 44 种扫描路径相似度度量，含基于 10 种 CNN/ViT/自监督编码器的无语言图像编码器度量。
AI.motivation: 现有显著性与扫描路径模型几乎只在自然照片上构建，而绘画在纹理、色彩与抽象程度上与照片差异显著，且是艺术家为引导视线而刻意构图的，因此需要艺术领域的眼动数据与评测基线来暴露现有模型的不足。
AI.method: 构建绘画自由观看眼动追踪数据集（多参与者、逐绘画个体扫描路径、注视时序、眼屏距离）；提供固定图、1°平滑显著图、时间显著视频与艺术元数据；对经典与深度显著性模型做与人类一致性基准评测；提出并排序 44 种扫描路径相似度度量，其中新引入 10 种图像编码器（CNN/ViT/自监督）构成的无语言度量族；通过去除观看偏差的对照实验分析人脸注视富集、局部结构、构图规则与艺术风格对注视一致性的影响。
AI.result: 艺术图像上现有经典与深度显著性模型与人类一致性仍存在明显提升空间；人脸被注视的频率约为期望值的数倍且在 0.5 秒内出现；局部结构吸引注视；由图像内容拟合的构图规则能预测注视位置；艺术风格影响观察者间一致性程度。
AI.conclusion: 绘画显著性与扫描路径建模是区别于自然照片的重要开放问题，该数据集、代码与 Python 包为艺术感知建模及扫描路径度量研究提供了标准化基准。
